children: Sweden's gross domestic product shrank 0.8% in July from June, preliminary data from the statistics office showed on Thursday.
That followed a 0.2% contraction the previous month.
Calendar adjusted GDP was 2.5% higher than in the corresponding month of the preceding year.

"Economic activity in the Swedish economy continued to decrease for the second month in a row and is now back around the levels seen in spring before the strong growth numbers in May," Statistics Sweden economist Mattias Kain Wyatt said.
"Year on year economic growth however remains clearly above the historical average seen over the preceding decade."
